title: Finding the Pivots to Repair Broken Source-Test Evolution Using LLMs
title_zh: 利用LLM寻找修复源代码-测试演化断裂的关键支点

paragraphs.en: 系统研究LLM测试修复的有效配置与推理行为，将Codex困难案例修复成功率提升66.7%。 Repairing obsolete tests in response to source code evolution is critical for test suite reliability and software quality assurance. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for automating many software development tasks, the effective supply of context and the orchestration of repair pipelines in this source--test co-evolution scenario remain poorly understood. Moreover, although reasoning is found helpful for LLMs on some complex coding tasks, it remains unclear which reasoning steps actually contribute to effective test repairs and how the insights learned from LLMs' behaviors benefit coding agents. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical study of test repair for source-test co-evolution empowered by LLMs, investigating the effective setups and typical LLM behaviors. To support this study, we construct a new benchmark of 500 real-world source-test co-evolution cases from commits submitted between May 2024 and April 2026 across 15 highly-starred open-source Java projects. Our experimental results reveal several key insights for effective LLM-based test repair: the complementary benefits of combining test failure symptoms, source code changes, and supportive code context, as well as the effectiveness of self-repair rounds. We further derive a common reasoning action taxonomy from LLMs' reasoning traces, which proves instrumental in guiding LLMs to repair tests more effectively while at a lower financial cost. Applying our findings to the Codex agent further improves its repair success rate on challenging cases by 66.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 系统研究了基于大语言模型（LLM）的测试修复的有效配置与推理行为，将Codex在困难案例上的修复成功率提升了66.7%。针对源代码演化的响应来修复过时测试，对测试套件的可靠性和软件质量保障至关重要。 尽管大语言模型（LLM）已成为自动化许多软件开发任务的有前景的工具，但在这种源代码—测试协同演化场景中，如何有效供给上下文以及如何编排修复流程仍知之甚少。 此外，尽管推理已被发现在某些复杂编码任务上对LLM有帮助，但哪些推理步骤真正有助于有效的测试修复，以及从LLM行为中获得的洞见如何惠及编码智能体，仍不清楚。 在本文中，我们对由LLM赋能的源代码—测试协同演化中的测试修复进行了系统的实证研究，考察了有效的配置和典型的LLM行为。 为支持该研究，我们构建了一个新的基准，包含来自15个高星标开源Java项目在2024年5月至2026年4月间提交的500个真实世界源代码—测试协同演化案例。 我们的实验结果揭示了有效的基于LLM的测试修复的若干关键洞见：结合测试失败症状、源代码变更与辅助代码上下文的互补收益，以及自修复轮次的有效性。 我们进一步从LLM的推理轨迹中推导出一个通用的推理动作分类法，事实证明它有助于引导LLM在更低财务成本下更有效地修复测试。 将我们的发现应用于Codex智能体，进一步使其在具有挑战性案例上的修复成功率提升了66.7%。
